text: Become anything: tap a creature with no spell in hand and press Become. If it walks, you see through its eyes and the rest of the page steps aside: drag to look, the stick at the bottom left walks it, and Strike, Eat or its own magic are buttons at the bottom right. Pick a spell from the bar at the bottom and cast it where the mark points, up to 14 steps away. The eye button takes you behind it; Let go gives it back its own mind.
